population.selection: SUMLEV=162 and POPESTIMATE2025>=100000; exclude Gazetteer LSAD57 CDP exception from incorporated eligibility; retain exception in audit.

coordinates.method: Join STATE+PLACE to GEOID; round INTPTLAT/INTPTLONG to 0.01 degrees. Representative internal points, not downtown centres or station coordinates.

amtrak.use: Stop names/URLs only, never schedules or current service availability.

limitations: Public Amtrak station-page HTTP requests were blocked in this environment; bulk evidence uses the successfully downloaded official GTFS stop directory. ArcGIS returned Token Required; no bypass or paid access attempted.
No municipal boundary overlay or operating-carrier verification. All municipal/carrier fields remain pending.
No Alaska verified operator market in this snapshot. Urban Honolulu CDP is outside the incorporated-place selection; Hawaii and territories are not silently inferred served.
All verified bus-listed smaller places are eligible independent of population. Regional/Amtrak directory expansion beyond recorded evidence is incomplete; no claim every small place is complete.
Missing directory match or insufficient page evidence is unresolved, never a claim of no service.
No runtime API/network request, live schedule, fare or city-pair route generation.
